scope: First-stage end-to-end repair map. Open findings are not fixed by a passing existing suite. Owner values are proposed responsibility areas, not assigned people.

findings.title: Fail closed on missing verification gates
findings.fix: Reject empty and whitespace-only verify commands at MCP and CLI boundaries; never mark a task done without a configured gate. Separate clean-stop from goal-met status.
findings.acceptance: Blank/missing/whitespace gates return not-met without spawning; nonzero/timeout remain not-met; exit-zero commands alone can pass a valid gate. Cover CLI and MCP.

findings.title: Keep JSON parseable under meter pressure and protocol warnings
findings.fix: Keep machine data in a structured envelope; deliver advisories separately. Apply protection to every JSON-producing tool, not only the compression path.
findings.acceptance: For all JSON tools, JSON.parse remains valid under ok/warn/handoff and strictness warn/block; exact retrieval remains byte-identical.

findings.title: Enforce advertised input schemas at runtime
findings.fix: Validate required keys, types, enums, bounds and additionalProperties before handler execution; return consistent protocol/tool errors with no side effects.
findings.acceptance: SDK stdio calls with omitted required text, wrong types, unknown properties, invalid enum, NaN/nonfinite internal inputs and oversized payloads are rejected; valid requests still work.

findings.title: Invalidate graph facts after edits, additions and deletions
findings.fix: Use bounded incremental invalidation shared by graph queries and search; retain reverse-index consistency and report stale/incomplete state.
findings.acceptance: Same-process and reopened-cache tests observe modified exports/imports, new files and deleted nodes without a manual rescan; reindex cost measured on a declared corpus.

findings.title: Stop substring matches from verifying false claims
findings.fix: Match symbol names exactly and compare resolved canonical file identities. Unsupported or ambiguous claims must be unparseable rather than verified.
findings.acceptance: A file exporting foobar contradicts exports foo; similarly named files/imports cannot verify each other; aliases, NodeNext paths and ambiguous module tails have explicit tests.

findings.title: Separate lifetime savings, session savings and live-window occupancy
findings.fix: Keep lifetime totals but calculate session deltas from a session boundary. Do not present accumulated or resent savings as a measured current-context counterfactual.
findings.acceptance: A fresh session with no optimization reports zero session savings despite lifetime history; replayed requests and MCP-plus-proxy paths cannot double-count the same replacement.

findings.title: Do not invent a larger context window when usage exceeds a configured limit
findings.fix: Respect explicit configuration and known model capacity. Surface overflow or unknown capacity instead of silently promoting a 200k window to 1M.
findings.acceptance: 210k observed in a configured 200k window stays overflow/handoff, not healthy at 21%; unknown models remain labelled unknown and host-specific capacities are tested.

findings.title: Apply never-expand and savings accounting to the final emitted response
findings.fix: Include wrapper text, handles and advisories in the final token budget; fall back when the full response expands. Measure emitted rather than internal skeleton tokens.
findings.acceptance: The 86-token fixture no longer emits 108 tokens while reporting a saving; sweep boundary-sized payloads, long file paths and warnings for read, optimize, hooks and proxy.

findings.title: Classify polite action requests and inflected write verbs correctly
findings.fix: Prioritize mutation intent over question punctuation and read words. Recognize create/update/fixes variants; make calibration unable to remove essential intent/risk rules.
findings.acceptance: Can you fix the bug? and Create a complete audit report and map needed fixes are actionable; explain the architecture remains inquiry. Report confusion matrix on a versioned task corpus.

findings.title: Use domain relevance and abstention for skill selection
findings.fix: Preserve the local generic-word improvement, then add coverage/specificity thresholds, negative-domain cases, tie handling and explainable match evidence. Abstain on weak matches.
findings.acceptance: Local resume regressions remain green; payments-discovery no longer wins an MCP audit via map/evidence alone; domain-labelled corpus and healthy/unhealthy skill cases pass.

findings.title: Promote resilient bounded scanning from local checkout to reviewed delivery
findings.fix: Review and deliver existing protected-child/symlink fixes; expose skipped-path counts and completeness. Choose a bounded root and limits rather than silently scanning a home tree.
findings.acceptance: EPERM/EACCES/disappearing children preserve readable siblings; inaccessible root and EIO still fail; symlink cycles stop; active-host root and coverage diagnostics verified after restart.

findings.title: Make recall lifetime and purge policy explicit
findings.fix: Document bounded retention, warn before irreversible eviction and consider pinning active-session handles. Clarify recovery availability rather than promising permanent losslessness.
findings.acceptance: Hot/cold round trips and corruption checks pass; eviction cannot silently remove pinned live handles; missing/expired handles return actionable errors; docs match server startup maintenance.

findings.title: Use one explicit project root for identity, queries and commands
findings.fix: Resolve and canonicalize root once; align KNITBRAIN_PROJECT_DIR, store IDs, knowledge scanning, file reads and verification cwd. Add startup diagnostics for the selected root.
findings.acceptance: Server launched outside the overridden project searches and verifies the intended project; nested worktrees and two simultaneous projects cannot share the wrong state.

findings.title: Prove concurrent read-modify-write safety and crash recovery
findings.fix: Evaluate transactions/locking or append-only events for shared counters and manifests. Atomic rename prevents partial files but does not itself prevent lost updates.
findings.acceptance: Multiprocess increments preserve exact expected totals; interleaved manifest writes preserve all handles; injected crash and corrupt-state recovery is deterministic and observable.

findings.title: Fail closed when requested worker isolation cannot be created
findings.evidence: src/fan.ts: worktreeFor returns process.cwd on failure
findings.fix: Refuse worker startup when isolation fails. Track per-task branch/artifact results separately from integration completion; keep integration review explicit.
findings.acceptance: Injected worktree creation failure runs zero agent commands in the shared checkout; independent-worker results cannot mark integrated acceptance met before reconciliation.

findings.title: Enforce deadlines inside subprocesses and surface incomplete exit semantics
findings.fix: Apply remaining wall-clock budgets to agent, verify and reviewer processes, including child-process cleanup; emit explicit met/stopped/error result distinctions.
findings.acceptance: Hanging child cannot outlive the declared deadline beyond bounded teardown; max/time-budget stops with unfinished tasks are machine-distinguishable from goal-met across MCP, CLI and fan.

findings.title: Return useful verification failure evidence and scope success to the actual command
findings.fix: Capture bounded sanitized stderr/stdout, exit/signal/timeout and attempt metadata. Keep rubric strings explicitly advisory unless actually evaluated.
findings.acceptance: Distinct compile/test/timeout failures retain differentiating evidence without credentials; a passing trivial command cannot be described as full task/rubric acceptance.

findings.title: Fix the published library quickstart
findings.fix: README now uses the actual API and handles passthrough; local documented-method/exact-recovery smoke passes. Still execute the copied example against the packed package in a fresh consumer.
findings.acceptance: A fresh consumer copies the README example and recovers the exact original; no missing method or undocumented option is required.

findings.title: Track source, installed binary, active MCP and npm as distinct artifacts
findings.fix: Introduce provenance/doctor output: version, commit/build, module path, root and integration mode. Keep release gates explicit; do not bump or publish as part of this audit.
findings.acceptance: Document npm 0.20.0 versus main 0.20.1; packed candidate and active-host smoke each attest their own artifact. Rollback/restart instructions tested separately.

findings.title: Triage and remediate existing upstream runtime advisories
findings.fix: Inventory direct/transitive advisories, establish reachable code paths and update compatible dependencies in a dedicated reviewed change. Do not use blind force upgrades.
findings.acceptance: npm audit --omit=dev has zero critical/high, or a reviewed time-bounded exception with reachability evidence; lockfile install, full verify and packed-consumer tests pass. Current report is not an exploit demonstration.

findings.title: Require review and status checks on main
findings.fix: Maintainer activates a ruleset or branch protection with actual CI check names, pull-request review, force-push/deletion controls and an explicit bypass policy.
findings.acceptance: GitHub API proves the active rule targets main and requires the intended checks/review; a failing PR cannot merge via the normal path. No organization/admin settings changed by this map.

findings.title: Harden CI supply chain and reproducibility
findings.evidence: actions use mutable v4 tags, latest OS labels and no explicit permissions
findings.fix: This branch adds contents:read, run concurrency and job timeouts. Still pin reviewed external action revisions and runner/toolchain policy; add dependency review/update policy.
findings.acceptance: Every external action has an attested revision; untrusted PR jobs have no write token/secrets; timed-out builds terminate; required-check names are stable.

findings.title: Extend existing green tests with adversarial end-to-end contracts
findings.fix: Convert each reproduced defect to a failing regression before its fix. Run schema/output/pressure/strictness and e2e:tools in CI, and verify the exact packed candidate commit.
findings.acceptance: Each P0/P1 fix has a red-before/green-after test; default strictness and error paths are exercised through stdio, not just direct handler calls; skipped live tests stay labelled.

findings.title: Measure task fidelity and net session benefit, not just round-trip availability
findings.fix: Version a shareable held-out corpus with question/answer and decision-critical content checks. Compare no optimization, retrieval only, compression only and combined modes.
findings.acceptance: Report raw/emitted/recall/retry/tool-schema tokens, correctness, completion rate, latency and cost on the same tasks; no claimed universal answer preservation or provider-billed savings from token heuristics alone.

findings.title: Bound full scans, repeated reads, tokenization and deep-parse work
findings.evidence: src/optimizer/router.ts: detect before byType size guard
findings.fix: Profile cold/warm search and compression by size; cache safe unchanged chunks after freshness is correct; apply input budgets before expensive parsing and synchronous IO.
findings.acceptance: Publish dataset sizes, machine/runtime, cold/warm p50/p95, memory and event-loop delay; no tuning accepted if task fidelity regresses. Budgets set from measurements, not invented speedups.

findings.title: Prove enforcement in actual supported hosts
findings.fix: Maintain a host/version capability ledger separating payload-fixture tests from connected-host invocation, deny/stop/rewrite and fallback behavior.
findings.acceptance: For every claimed platform, record version and real lifecycle evidence or label unverified/advisory; OAuth tool-surface savings remain separate from API-proxy measurements.

findings.title: Verify setup, upgrades, reconnect and removal without clobbering host config
findings.evidence: src/global-config.ts; active host still showed old routing/search behavior
findings.fix: Test idempotent config merge, scoped roots, executable resolution, backups and uninstall/rollback. Emit stale-server/build diagnostics instead of implying a rebuild changed the running process.
findings.acceptance: Fresh install and upgrade preserve unrelated settings; reconnect reports the expected binary/root and passes read/recall/search probes; no live configuration changed silently.

findings.title: Review sensitive local retention and optional network boundaries
findings.fix: Define which raw outputs/transcripts enter CCR versus scrubbed memory, file modes and project isolation. Document provider/hub egress, deletion/backup policy and opt-in import behavior.
findings.acceptance: Synthetic secret canaries prove intended redaction and isolation; raw exact-recall storage is disclosed accurately; permissions and hub/proxy access controls tested. Novel vulnerability details stay private under SECURITY.md.

findings.title: Bound enforcement claims to the actual permission mechanism
findings.evidence: literal constraint rules and documented fail-open behavior; src/hooks/index.ts
findings.fix: Document hooks as host-dependent policy assistance rather than a sandbox. Specify behavior when config/hooks fail and distinguish arbitrary user-authorized shell execution from enforced project restrictions.
findings.acceptance: A versioned command/host matrix tests direct and equivalent command forms plus missing/broken hooks; unsupported constraints are labelled unenforced rather than advertised as physically guaranteed.

findings.title: Measure standing protocol/tool-schema overhead and response verbosity
findings.evidence: src/server.ts: tools/list; repeated protocol text observed in connected tool descriptions
findings.fix: Measure native tools/list and host-enriched descriptions separately. Avoid repeating instructions per tool where the host permits shared instructions; deduplicate command inventories.
findings.acceptance: Record cold session overhead plus per-task tool/result tokens before/after; retain required operating guidance and do not attribute host-added repetition to source without measurement.

findings.title: Keep one traceable public repair backlog and review workflow
findings.fix: Add linked audit index, machine-readable findings, reproduction evidence, dependency order, contribution instructions and issue/PR templates. Do not open dozens of speculative issues.
findings.acceptance: All IDs, sources, evidence fragments and dependencies validate; tool inventory covers all 37 tools; the public branch/PR identifies implemented versus open work and preserves private security disclosure.

findings.title: Align declared Node support and actual CI coverage
findings.fix: Choose and document a supported runtime policy based on dependency engines; test the minimum and current supported LTS versions on relevant operating systems, including macOS host fixtures.
findings.acceptance: Declared minimum can install/run the packed artifact; CI matrix matches policy; compatibility changes get explicit release notes, not an untested engine claim.
